notes: A main menu that is the panel itself, not a card floating over the screen: a full-size cover over the window, so the panel reveals onto the menu, the sidebar stays hidden underneath until Enter, and Enter fades the cover away to show it. The first version drew a small centred card and left the sidebar visible beside it, which was not what a main menu is. The loading bar completes, the panel does not appear on its own any more: a card takes its place with the wordmark, the build and rev, and Enter / Settings / Credits. Enter fades the hub in. Settings is a shortcut into the real Settings tab, not a second copy, so the tab list is unchanged once you are in. Credits resolves 1562524075 when the menu is built - display name and user name from the Players API, with the in-game player and a name lookup as fallbacks if the batch call is unavailable - so the card never shows a stale hardcoded name. The menu holds the window back rather than racing the reveal: it waits for loadingDone, hides the window and shadow, and restores both exactly where the reveal left them.
